INSERT INTO impostos_obrigacoes (
    cliente_id,
    tipo_imposto,
    competencia,
    data_vencimento,
    valor,
    status,
    observacoes,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    registro_status,
    origem_lancamento
)
SELECT
    c.id AS cliente_id,
    co.nome_obrigacao AS tipo_imposto,
    DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') AS competencia,
    STR_TO_DATE(
        CONCAT(
            DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-'),
            LPAD(
                LEAST(
                    COALESCE(co.dia_vencimento, DAY(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()))),
                    DAY(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()))
                ),
                2,
                '0'
            )
        ),
        '%Y-%m-%d'
    ) AS data_vencimento,
    0.00 AS valor,
    'pendente' AS status,
    CONCAT(
        'Gerado automaticamente pela rotina. ',
        'Categoria: ', COALESCE(co.categoria, ''),
        ' | Esfera: ', COALESCE(co.esfera, ''),
        ' | Área: ', COALESCE(co.area_responsavel, ''),
        ' | Periodicidade: ', COALESCE(co.periodicidade, ''),
        ' | Exige cliente: ', CASE WHEN COALESCE(co.exige_cliente, 0) = 1 THEN 'sim' ELSE 'nao' END,
        ' | Dias antecedência: ', COALESCE(co.dias_antecedencia, 5)
    ) AS observacoes,
    NOW() AS created_at,
    NOW() AS updated_at,
    'Ativo' AS registro_status,
    'rotina' AS origem_lancamento
FROM clientes c
INNER JOIN catalogo_obrigacoes co
    ON COALESCE(co.ativo, 1) = 1
   AND COALESCE(co.status_obrigacao, 'Ativa') = 'Ativa'
WHERE c.status = 'Ativo'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(co.periodicidade, ''))) IN (
      'mensal',
      'mensalmente',
      'mes',
      'mês'
  )
  AND co.dia_vencimento IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM impostos_obrigacoes io
      WHERE io.cliente_id = c.id
        AND io.tipo_imposto = co.nome_obrigacao
        AND io.competencia = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
        AND io.deleted_at IS NULL
  );

UPDATE impostos_obrigacoes
SET status = 'vencido',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE status = 'pendente'
  AND data_vencimento < CURDATE()
  AND registro_status = 'Ativo'
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

INSERT INTO logs_auditoria (
    funcionario_id,
    acao,
    tabela_afetada,
    registro_id,
    detalhes,
    ip_origem
)
SELECT
    NULL,
    'cron_obrigacoes_geracao_mensal',
    'impostos_obrigacoes',
    NULL,
    CONCAT(
        '{"competencia":"', DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m'),
        '","geradas_hoje":',
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM impostos_obrigacoes x
         WHERE x.competencia = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
           AND x.origem_lancamento = 'rotina'
           AND DATE(x.created_at) = CURDATE()
           AND x.deleted_at IS NULL),
        ',"vencidas_ativas":',
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM impostos_obrigacoes y
         WHERE y.status = 'vencido'
           AND y.registro_status = 'Ativo'
           AND y.deleted_at IS NULL),
        ',"executado_em":"', NOW(), '"}'
    ),
    'n8n CRON';

SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') AS competencia,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM impostos_obrigacoes a
     WHERE a.competencia = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
       AND a.origem_lancamento = 'rotina'
       AND DATE(a.created_at) = CURDATE()
       AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) AS geradas_hoje,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM impostos_obrigacoes b
     WHERE b.competencia = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
       AND b.origem_lancamento = 'rotina'
       AND b.registro_status = 'Ativo'
       AND b.deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_rotina_competencia,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM impostos_obrigacoes c
     WHERE c.status = 'vencido'
       AND c.registro_status = 'Ativo'
       AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_vencidas_ativas,
    NOW() AS executado_em;
